notes.title: Patch Drop & New Creepy Shift on the Way!
notes.notes:
Heya creeps!

We’ve just dropped a big patch packed with improvements, fixes, and tweaks based on your feedback:

🛠️ Added plumbing wrench mechanics – you can now fix the kitchen faucet

🎮 Fixed incorrect button icons in the UI

🚀 Improved overall game optimization

👁️ Fixed FOV-related graphical glitches

🐞 General gameplay bug fixes

📊 Improved scoreboard and difficulty balancing

💾 Fixed save system – checkpoint boxes now appear on pallets

🎵 Added music mute option in the main menu (separate slider)

🤲 Polished hand animations and item-carrying ergonomics

But that's not all...

We’re thrilled to announce that the [b]next chapter in the Creepy Shift [/b]series is in the works!
We are cooking surreal blend of simulation, horror, and psychological depth, all wrapped in a dark noir atmosphere.

Game page just went live – don’t miss it!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3734400/Creepy_Shift_Uncle_Joes_Motel/

Creepy hugs!
— Night Shift Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0 – Improvements, Fixes, and Performance Boost!
notes.notes:
Dear Creeps,

We’re arriving with our very first patch, and here’s what we’ve managed to improve:

[list]
[*] Performance optimizations
[*] Fixed video playback issues on Steam Deck
[*] Fixed issues with Chinese, Korean, and Japanese texts
[*] Translation corrections
[*] Improved controller support
[/list]
The game has been tested on Steam Deck and runs smoothly and fully playable. We’re now waiting for official verification from Steam :)

Thanks for your support! 👾

NST
